component.name: Replay Buffer Pro
component.summary: Save replay buffer clips of any length

description.p: Replay Buffer Pro adds a dock to OBS Studio with save buttons for clips of different lengths. Keep a long replay buffer running and save the last 30 seconds, 2 minutes or 5 minutes on demand, from the dock, a hotkey or obs-websocket.
Each clip is cut from the saved replay without re-encoding, so it keeps the quality of the original.
